_comment: Watchdog member list. One entry per member the watchdog should keep alive. 'start' is the command used when that member is not listening (first item = executable, rest = arguments). Add a new member by adding one entry here - no script edit needed.

members.why: Codex 通道（app-server）必须经 cmd 启动：自启动链直接 spawn codex.exe 会 ENOENT
DeepSeek 目前只是心跳监听（无 responder），保证在线状态真实可见
WorkBuddy 接入后把 enabled 改为 true 即可纳管；若它自带常驻通道，则保持 false（黑板不需要重复拉起）
